name: Gold Safe-Haven Deep Crisis Overlay
description: Stress-triggered overlay tuned for rare, deep drawdowns that dynamically tilts weight toward gold (SGLN) when equity markets experience severe drawdown. Starts with equal-weight base and tilts toward SGLN when equity blend drawdown from 6-month high falls below -20% trigger threshold. Based on Baur & Lucey (2010) finding that gold acts as a safe haven specifically during deep market stress. Tilt decays back to base weights over subsequent rebalances.
